contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus, House of Valentinian (Reece period 19). Mint: Possibly Lyons AD 364-378. Reverse legend reads: [SECVRITAS REIPVBLICAE]. Reverse: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Obverse legend illegible. Obverse: Bust facing right. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.38g, diameter is 18mm
